lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她死了。我去认过尸。
lines.en: She's dead. I went and identified the body.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 报纸上那篇研究，是我交出去的。登出来了。同一天早上，他们说她突发急病。
lines.en: That research in the paper—I handed it over. It ran. The same morning, they said she died of a sudden illness.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他们让我签一张确认死亡的纸。
lines.en: They had me sign a paper confirming the death.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 签的时候手没抖。出来以后才抖。
lines.en: My hand didn't shake while I signed. It started after I came out.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 公司问我要不要对报纸说两句。我说不用。他们看起来还挺高兴。
lines.en: The company asked if I wanted to say something to the paper. I said no. They looked rather pleased.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我不打算去闹。闹了，他们只会说家属情绪不稳。
lines.en: I'm not going to make a scene. If I did, they'd just say the family is unstable.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我不打算再从头讲一遍。你只要知道，她没有等到我。
lines.en: I'm not going to tell it from the beginning again. You only need to know she didn't wait for me.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我不想让别人替她写她。她的死不该拿去做文章。
lines.en: I don't want other people writing her for her. Her death shouldn't be turned into copy.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我今天不想说研究，也不想说下一步。你这儿安静，暂时够了。
lines.en: I don't want to talk about the research today, or what comes next. It's quiet here. For now that's enough.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你这椅子还是老样子。挺好。
lines.en: Your chair is the same as ever. Good.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 以前那件事，到这儿为止。工钱是我干活挣的。以后别再提。
lines.en: That old arrangement ends here. I earned the wages by working. Don't bring it up again.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我走了。明天我可能还来，别问为什么。
lines.en: I'm going. I might come again tomorrow. Don't ask why.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 旧居退回来的，只有这些。能拿回来的，比我想的少。
lines.en: This is all the old place gave back. Less than I expected to recover.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 银梳子、手套、一只钟，还有几块没裁的料子。以前留着，好像那条路还在。
lines.en: A silver comb, gloves, a clock, and a few uncut lengths of cloth. I kept them as if that road were still open.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 有几件是给我妈挑的。她没等到。
lines.en: Some of it I picked out for my mother. She didn't live to see it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚找过我。我没回。她让我回上面避一避，我不想听。
lines.en: Lydia came looking for me. I didn't answer. She wanted me to go back upstairs and lie low. I didn't want to hear it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她要是来问你，别替她劝。
lines.en: If she comes asking you, don't plead her case.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 箱底还有一张我妈写的农场清单。
lines.en: There's a farm list my mother wrote at the bottom of the box.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 二号培养槽该换滤芯，三号灯不亮。
lines.en: Tank two needs a new filter. Lamp three is out.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 都是小事。她到最后还在操心哪个灯不亮。这个不卖。
lines.en: Small things. At the end she was still worrying about which lamp was out. This isn't for sale.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 看仔细。那只钟以前整点会响，现在不响了，但还能走。
lines.en: Look closely. That clock used to chime on the hour. It doesn't now, but it still runs.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你挑能卖的。该多少就多少，别压价，也别因为是我的东西多给。
lines.en: Pick what you can sell. Pay what it's worth. Don't lowball me, and don't pay extra because it was mine.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 行了，剩下的我带走。空箱子也有用。
lines.en: All right, I'll take the rest. An empty box is still useful.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这次收不了就下次。东西我带走，不放在你这儿。
lines.en: If you can't take it this time, then next time. I'll take it with me. I'm not leaving it here.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 下次来，我不带这些了。带什么，再说。
lines.en: Next time I won't bring these. What I bring, we'll see.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我入队了。以后来买武器和药品。
lines.en: I joined up. From now on I'll come for weapons and medicine.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他们没答应替我报仇，可他们真在做事。队里肯继续把研究的事往外捅，我在里面跑补给。
lines.en: They didn't promise to avenge me, but they're actually doing something. The unit will keep pushing the research out. I run supplies for them.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 队里缺止血的、退烧的、消毒的。武器要轻一点，我还没那么大力气。
lines.en: We're short on bleeding control, fever meds, disinfectant. Weapons should be light. I'm not that strong yet.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 好看没用。我要能开枪、能收起来，坏了也不会卡住我。
lines.en: Looking good is useless. I need something that fires, folds up, and won't jam on me when it breaks.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 开枪我学过了。挑枪还不会，坏了也不会修。
lines.en: I've learned to shoot. I can't pick a gun yet, and I can't fix one when it breaks.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 钱是我自己的，够多少算多少。别给我算成你养的。
lines.en: The money is mine, and I'll buy what it covers. Don't count me as your dependent.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 钱照算。真想送，就送给队里，别送给我一个人。
lines.en: Charge me properly. If you really want to give something away, give it to the unit. Not to me alone.

blocks.scene: R04 有货并可实际检视

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这个能用。这个不要。我不会用。
lines.en: This one works. Not that one. I don't know how to use it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 药别拆包装，路上要分。
lines.en: Don't open the medicine. It has to be split up on the road.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这次没有合适的。下次有货再说。
lines.en: Nothing suitable this time. We'll talk when you have stock.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 药和工具的单子我留下，你按能弄到的来。
lines.en: I'll leave the medicine and tool list. Bring what you can get.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我不带人来这儿。你这店还要开，我不能让它变成革命军的门房。
lines.en: I won't bring people here. Your shop still has to run. I can't turn it into the revolution's front desk.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 下次来，我再带新单子。现在是我自己的，以后不一定。
lines.en: Next time I'll bring a new list. Right now it's mine. Later, maybe not.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我没再回她消息。她总会明白的。
lines.en: I haven't answered her messages. She'll understand eventually.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 公司的仓库。后墙有个卸货口，锁是旧的，警报都没响。
lines.en: A company warehouse. There's a loading door in the back wall. The lock was old. The alarm didn't even go off.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 一开始挺痛快。真的。出来以后我才发现，我一路没敢喘气。
lines.en: At first it felt good. Really. Only after we got out did I realize I hadn't dared breathe the whole way.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 到巷子里，手一直抖，东西都差点掉了。
lines.en: In the alley my hands kept shaking. I almost dropped everything.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 现在看见货就想起价钱，没那么抖。
lines.en: Now when I look at the goods I think of the price. It shakes less.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 没人受伤，这次没有。
lines.en: No one was hurt. Not this time.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 搬东西时外面还有人抽烟。我听见他咳嗽，差点把箱子扔了。
lines.en: While we were moving things, someone outside was smoking. I heard him cough and almost dropped the crate.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他走了。我们搬完才敢喘气。
lines.en: Then he left. We didn't breathe until we were done.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这事别跟别人说。
lines.en: Don't tell anyone about this.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 两盒针，三把钳子，还有一箱阀门。阀门你看着给。
lines.en: Two boxes of needles, three pairs of pliers, and a crate of valves. Price the valves as you see fit.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这算第一袋。钱我收下，东西归你。
lines.en: That's the first bag. I'll take the money. The goods are yours.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你不收，我找别家。东西不能压在我手里。
lines.en: If you won't take it, I'll find someone else. I can't let this sit on me.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我走了，别把这事想得太重。
lines.en: I'm going. Don't make too much of it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 下次什么时候来，等行动完再说。
lines.en: When I come next depends on the next job.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我回过住处，坐不住。天没亮就出来了，换了衣服还是坐不住。
lines.en: I went back to my room and couldn't sit still. I left before dawn. I changed clothes and still couldn't sit still.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我杀了人。
lines.en: I killed someone.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他先开的枪，冲着乔去的。我没有犹豫，至少当时没有。
lines.en: He fired first. At Joe. I didn't hesitate. Not then, at least.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我开了一枪，就一枪。他打偏了，我没受伤。
lines.en: I fired once. Just once. He missed. I wasn't hurt.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 乔吓坏了，我让他先走。他活下来了。
lines.en: Joe was terrified. I told him to go first. He made it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 枪响比我以为的闷。
lines.en: The shot was duller than I expected.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 乔问我怎么了。我说没事。他信了。
lines.en: Joe asked what was wrong. I said nothing. He believed me.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他倒下的时候，手里还夹着烟。烟掉在地上，没灭。
lines.en: When he fell, he still had a cigarette between his fingers. It dropped and kept burning.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我一直看见那根烟。我不后悔，可我闭眼就看见它。
lines.en: I keep seeing that cigarette. I don't regret it, but when I close my eyes it's there.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我连他叫什么都不知道。有没有孩子也不知道。只知道他差点打死乔。
lines.en: I don't even know his name. Whether he had kids. I only know he almost killed Joe.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 住处也安静，可那儿静得不对。一静下来，我就觉得门外有人。
lines.en: My room is quiet too, but it's the wrong kind of quiet. When it's still, I think someone's outside the door.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你这儿不一样。我反而想坐。
lines.en: It's different here. Here I actually want to sit.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你这儿有没有吃的。给我留一点，别问我要不要紧。
lines.en: Do you have anything to eat? Leave me some. Don't ask if I'm all right.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: 有面包。
lines.en: There's bread.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 也别告诉队里我来过。
lines.en: And don't tell the unit I came here.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 外套还我。
lines.en: Give me my coat back.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 今晚我回队里，不回去更麻烦。
lines.en: I'm going back to the unit tonight. Not going back would be more trouble.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我再坐一会儿。就一会儿。
lines.en: I'll sit a little longer. Just a little.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我走了。下次不用等到开门。
lines.en: I'm going. Next time you don't have to wait for opening.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 看情况。
lines.en: Depends.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这次单子归我管。米拉膝盖不好，雨天也得跟队。
lines.en: This time the list is mine. Mira's knees are bad, and she still has to march in the rain.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 米拉的药以前是我顺手带的。现在整队的单子都归我。
lines.en: I used to pick up Mira's medicine along the way. Now the whole unit's list is mine.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她管仓库，膝盖是搬货时坏的。她不肯用拐，说拄着拐跑不快。
lines.en: She runs the stores. She wrecked her knees hauling goods. She won't use a cane—says she can't run fast with one.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她让我别跟队里说她膝盖疼。
lines.en: She made me promise not to tell the unit her knees hurt.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她走路慢，可从不让人等。她要知道我替她记着，肯定不乐意。
lines.en: She walks slow, but she never makes anyone wait. If she knew I was keeping track for her, she'd hate it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 还有两个人的工具，老是坏。这次有多的，给新来的留一份。我自己的排后面。
lines.en: Two others' tools keep breaking. If there are extras this time, leave a set for the new one. My own can wait.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 新来的连药名都认不全，我让他先背。
lines.en: The new one can't even name the medicines. I told him to memorize them first.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我把单子按人分开，谁缺什么写清楚。
lines.en: I split the list by person. Whoever's short, it's written clearly.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 一天要对三遍，还是怕漏。
lines.en: I check it three times a day and still worry I'll miss something.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚没睡好。今天能把单子对完就行。
lines.en: Didn't sleep well. Today I just need to get through the list.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他们连绷带都缠不好。教，骂完再教。
lines.en: They can't even wrap a bandage. I teach them, yell, then teach them again.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 下次带好货来。我尽量带得回来。
lines.en: Bring good stock next time. I'll try to bring myself back.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 行动里分到的。来源干净不干净，你自己看。
lines.en: Got it in the job. Whether it's clean or not, judge for yourself.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 银的，盖子内侧有镜子。这个不能这么掰，会把铰链弄松。
lines.en: Silver, with a mirror inside the lid. Don't pry it like that. You'll loosen the hinge.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 以前我用过同款。盖子内侧要这样擦。
lines.en: I used to have the same kind. You wipe the inside of the lid like this.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我记得怎么擦。可我想不起她最后一次笑是什么样。
lines.en: I remember how to clean it. But I can't remember the last time I saw her smile.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 只记得那天在农场，她手上全是泥。
lines.en: I only remember that day at the farm. Her hands were covered in mud.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我讨厌那套日子。可这东西做得挺好看。
lines.en: I hated that life. But this thing is well made.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 家里以前有一整套。我母亲挑东西，先看用，再看样子。
lines.en: We had a whole set at home. My mother picked things by use first, looks second.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 以前买这种东西要提前订，店员会把盒子送到家里，连价签都不留。
lines.en: We used to order things like this ahead. The clerk would deliver the box to the house and not even leave the price tag.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 现在我自己搬，挺好。
lines.en: Now I carry it myself. That's fine.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: 按货算。
lines.en: Price it by the goods.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 别给我情面价。该多少是多少，别因为我用过就多给。
lines.en: Don't give me a pity price. What it's worth is what it's worth. Don't pay extra because I used it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这次不买就下次。东西我带走，不放在你这儿。
lines.en: If you don't buy it now, next time. I'll take it with me. Not leaving it here.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 下次带别的来。
lines.en: I'll bring something else next time.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 米拉没回来。名单上少了一个。
lines.en: Mira didn't come back. One name short on the list.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她的名字还在上面。我划了一道，没划透。
lines.en: Her name is still there. I crossed it out once. Didn't press hard enough.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我不想说战斗。单子还要对完。
lines.en: I don't want to talk about the fight. The list still has to be checked.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她领药总把糖纸留下，说攒够一把能换糖。
lines.en: She always kept the candy wrappers when she picked up medicine. Said a handful could be traded for candy.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她死的时候，桌上还有半把。
lines.en: When she died, there was half a handful on the table.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她总把绷带叠成很小的方块。我说那样拆起来慢，她说省地方。
lines.en: She always folded bandages into tiny squares. I said it was slow to unfold. She said it saved space.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她比我小两岁。总说要活到战争结束。
lines.en: She was two years younger than me. Always said she'd live to see the war end.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 队里知道了。有人哭，有人去擦枪。我来对单子。
lines.en: The unit knows. Some cried. Some went to clean their guns. I came to check the list.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她那半把糖纸我收起来了。她家里没人来，东西是我收的。
lines.en: I kept those wrappers. No one from her family came. I collected her things.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 按单子来。多的留给别人，她那份不用留了。
lines.en: Follow the list. Extras go to the others. There's no need to keep her share.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她那份，我给新来的了。
lines.en: Her share—I gave it to the new one.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 少一个人，单子就短一行。短得让人不敢看。
lines.en: One person less, and the list is one line shorter. So short I can't stand to look at it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我走了。等我把这行看习惯再来。
lines.en: I'm going. I'll come back when I'm used to seeing that line.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我放跑了一个。不重要。追下去能打死两个，可乔的腿等不了。
lines.en: I let one go. It doesn't matter. If I'd chased, I could have killed two. But Joe's leg couldn't wait.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 背不动，我拖着他走了两条街。有人来接，我手到现在还酸。
lines.en: He couldn't be carried. I dragged him two streets. Someone came for us later. My arms still ache.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他醒过来第一句话是问枪还在不在。我说在，他才睡。
lines.en: The first thing he asked when he woke was whether the gun was still there. I said yes. Then he slept.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: 乔的腿怎么样？
lines.en: How's Joe's leg?

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 保住了。人还在。
lines.en: Saved. He's still here.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他们问我追不追。我说不追。说完就想反悔。
lines.en: They asked if I wanted to chase. I said no. The moment I said it, I wanted to take it back.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 可反悔也不能把人扔下。
lines.en: But taking it back wouldn't mean leaving him behind.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 下次也一样，先带活的回来。
lines.en: Next time too. Bring the living back first.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 丢的那批货，队里没人提。越没人提，我越记得。
lines.en: No one in the unit mentions the lost shipment. The less they mention it, the more I remember.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我还是恨他们。
lines.en: I still hate them.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他们开始听我的。我把药分得明白，能活命的事，他们当然听。
lines.en: They've started listening to me. I divide the medicine clearly. When it's about staying alive, of course they listen.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 乔要是恨我放跑那个人，让他自己追。他昨天先问我，药够不够。
lines.en: If Joe hates me for letting that one go, he can chase him himself. Yesterday the first thing he asked was whether we had enough medicine.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 清单带来了，这次多两个人的。谁缺药，谁的工具该换，我都记着。
lines.en: I brought the list. Two more people this time. Who's short on medicine, whose tools need replacing—I've got it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我缺觉，这个你补不了。
lines.en: I'm short on sleep. That's not something you can supply.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 货备齐了叫我。乔的腿别再问，他不喜欢。我的也别问。
lines.en: Call me when the stock's ready. Don't ask about Joe's leg again. He doesn't like it. Don't ask about mine either.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 走了。
lines.en: I'm off.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 今天没货。
lines.en: No goods today.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 那你还让我进来？
lines.en: And you still let me in?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: 门又没锁。
lines.en: The door isn't locked.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你这话说得真难接。
lines.en: That's really hard to answer.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 队里今天没安排。我坐不住。
lines.en: Nothing scheduled today. I couldn't sit still.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 今天客人少。正好。
lines.en: Few customers today. Good.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这只杯子有缺口。你也不换。
lines.en: This cup's chipped. You still haven't replaced it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 缺口朝外。客人拿了不割手？
lines.en: The chip faces out. Won't a customer cut themselves?

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 换一个吧，又不贵。
lines.en: Replace it. It's not expensive.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 货架也歪了。你天天从这儿过，也不扶。
lines.en: The shelf's crooked too. You walk past it every day and don't straighten it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他们现在说话都先看我。我不喜欢。
lines.en: Now they all look at me before they speak. I don't like it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 累。还行。
lines.en: Tired. It's all right.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我坐一会儿。你忙你的，不用陪我说话。
lines.en: I'll sit for a while. Do your work. You don't have to talk to me.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 有人问，你自己解释。
lines.en: If anyone asks, you explain it yourself.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 看什么？没什么就别看了。
lines.en: What are you looking at? If there's nothing, don't look.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我走了。下次来，杯子再不换，我就自己动手。
lines.en: I'm going. Next time, if the cup isn't replaced, I'll do it myself.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 没货也来。
lines.en: I'll come even when there's no stock.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这次送人。
lines.en: This time I'm moving people.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 一个抄过研究记录的技工，一个给研究所送过货的司机。还有司机七岁的妹妹。
lines.en: A technician who copied research records. A driver who delivered to the institute. And the driver's seven-year-old sister.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 妹妹什么都不知道，只是跟着走。公司追他们，所以不能走大路。
lines.en: The sister knows nothing. She's just coming along. The company is after them, so we can't take the main road.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 路线我安排好了，不跟你说。
lines.en: I've planned the route. I'm not telling you.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他们也不知道路，只要知道跟着我。我跟另一个人轮流带路。
lines.en: They don't know the route either. They just need to follow me. Another one and I take turns leading.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 那个技工把经手人和路线都背下来了。他说纸会被搜走，脑子不会。
lines.en: The technician memorized the handlers and the route. He said paper gets searched. Brains don't.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 药别装在最上面，路上潮。绷带单独包一层。
lines.en: Don't pack the medicine on top. It's damp on the road. Wrap the bandages separately.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 食物够两天，多了跑不快。
lines.en: Food for two days. More will slow us down.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 两天不够也得够。你以前不用管这些。
lines.en: Two days will have to be enough. You never had to worry about this before.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 回来以后，我想吃硬糖。随便哪种。别买多，占地方。
lines.en: When I get back, I want hard candy. Any kind. Don't buy much. It takes up space.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 那个技工一直在看一张画，是他女儿画的。她没跟来。
lines.en: The technician keeps looking at a drawing his daughter made. She isn't coming.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 司机妹妹一直问我，外面是不是比里面好。
lines.en: The driver's sister keeps asking me if it's better outside than inside.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我说不一定，至少能自己走。
lines.en: I said not necessarily. At least you can walk on your own.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她鞋不合脚，走两步就掉。我给她绑了根绳。
lines.en: Her shoes don't fit. They slip off after two steps. I tied them on for her.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 再检查一遍。检查三遍了，那就第四遍。
lines.en: Check it again. I've checked three times, so this makes four.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 最后一批也到了，清单齐了。我自己都嫌烦。
lines.en: The last batch is in. The list is complete. Even I'm sick of it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 账本别记错。回来我查。
lines.en: Don't mess up the ledger. I'll check when I'm back.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: 店开着，人也等。
lines.en: The shop stays open. And someone waits.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你这个人。回来以后先说糖，别的再说。别弄太多，我不一定吃得下。
lines.en: You. When I'm back, candy first. Everything else after. Don't get too much. I might not be able to eat it all.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 店还开着。那就好。
lines.en: The shop's still open. Good.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 人送到了，一个没少。我也回来了，你看得见。
lines.en: Everyone delivered. Not one missing. And I'm back. You can see that.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 那个七岁的妹妹一路问到了没有。我说没有，问了三遍。
lines.en: The seven-year-old asked the whole way whether we were there yet. I said no. Three times.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她到地方就睡着了。她哥抱着她下的车。
lines.en: She fell asleep as soon as we arrived. Her brother carried her off.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 她鞋上那根绳还在。
lines.en: The string's still on her shoe.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 路上不算顺利。有一辆车坏了，我们推了两里。人没事，车扔了。
lines.en: The road wasn't smooth. A car broke down. We pushed it two li. No one was hurt. We left the car.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我胳膊擦了一下，没伤到骨头。换了药，自己换的。你先看货。
lines.en: I scraped my arm. Nothing broken. Changed the dressing myself. Look at the goods first.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这批是路上分到的。公司给押运队的，现在到我们手里了。
lines.en: This is what we picked up on the road. Company issue for the escort team. Now it's ours.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 路上遇到追兵。我们没停，绕过去了。
lines.en: We ran into pursuers. We didn't stop. Went around them.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 货也带回来了。
lines.en: The goods came back too.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这批你好好看，别当普通货收。价钱照谈，我不白送。
lines.en: Look this batch over properly. Don't take it as ordinary stock. We'll still talk price. I'm not giving it away.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 店里没人来找麻烦就好。我最怕回来看到门关着。
lines.en: Good, no one came looking for trouble. What I feared most was coming back to a closed door.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 队里说这次算成了。就这一次，别想太远。
lines.en: The unit says this one counts as a success. Just this one. Don't think too far ahead.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这两天我想把货架收拾一遍，你别拦我。
lines.en: I want to sort the shelves these next couple of days. Don't stop me.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我得回去交差。明天早上我再来，别太早开门。我说了别太早。
lines.en: I have to report back. I'll come tomorrow morning. Don't open too early. I said not too early.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 队里放两天。我睡到天亮才起。
lines.en: The unit gave us two days. I slept until dawn.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 今天没货，也没单子。
lines.en: No goods today. No list either.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚又是面包，方便。
lines.en: Bread again last night. Convenient.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 外面风大。我走过来的时候，街上还没人。
lines.en: It's windy out. The street was empty when I walked over.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 那你别忙。坐会儿。
lines.en: Then don't be busy. Sit for a while.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 下次进货，给我留两盒你店里那种饼干。
lines.en: Next time you stock up, save me two boxes of those biscuits you carry.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 队里新来的孩子，第一次出任务吐了一路。总不能让他饿着。
lines.en: The new kid in the unit threw up the whole first mission. Can't let him go hungry.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 队里下个月要换驻地，不算远，还能来。
lines.en: The unit's moving next month. Not far. I can still come.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我以后可能还会带伤回来。你别每次都问要不要紧。
lines.en: I might come back hurt again. Don't ask every time if it's serious.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 问我要不要吃点什么。我还不饿。
lines.en: Ask if I want something to eat. I'm not hungry yet.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你今天不开门？
lines.en: Aren't you opening today?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: 晚点开。
lines.en: Later.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 那我不占你太久。你这店里还是这么冷。炉子坏了就坐近点。
lines.en: Then I won't keep you long. It's still so cold in here. If the heater's broken, sit closer.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 今天没有打算，就在这儿待着。
lines.en: No plans today. Just staying here.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 空着的时候，我会想下一批货、下一队人。
lines.en: When there's nothing else, I think about the next shipment, the next group of people.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 今天不想。
lines.en: Today I don't.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我把杯子放这儿。
lines.en: I'll put the cup here.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我想见你。
lines.en: I want to see you.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这盒别给我算便宜，队里用的是这个数。包装别拆，路上不好带。
lines.en: Don't give me a discount on this box. The unit uses this price. Don't open the packaging. It's hard to carry on the road.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 检查可以，别拆坏。药这种东西，省不得。
lines.en: You can inspect it. Don't break it. You can't skimp on medicine.

blocks.scene: 日常 R04—R05 卖小批货

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这批里有三个一样的。
lines.en: There are three identical ones in this batch.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你挑着收，我不想为三件一样的东西讲三遍价。给我算一批。
lines.en: Take what you want. I don't want to haggle three times for three identical things. Price it as one lot.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这才像做生意。
lines.en: Now that's doing business.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 有没有不容易坏的？我不想再拿一把拧两下就断的。
lines.en: Got anything that won't break? I don't want another one that snaps after two turns.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这把贵可以，断了更贵。你倒是会算，跟你学的。
lines.en: This one can be expensive. A broken one costs more. You're good at this. I learned from you.

blocks.scene: 日常 R04—R05 正常买卖

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 营养果现在多少钱？老价钱的话拿两袋，路上吃。别问那么多。
lines.en: How much is nutrifruit now? If it's the old price, two bags for the road. Don't ask so many questions.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你店里也小心。
lines.en: Be careful in the shop too.

blocks.scene: 日常 R06 后至 G1 声响

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 没事。
lines.en: It's nothing.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你这杯子有缺口。我还是那句话：先用着，用惯了。
lines.en: This cup's chipped. I'll say it again: keep using it until you're used to it.

blocks.scene: 日常 R06 后至 G1 核对清单

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 米拉的药别拿错，她吃错会起疹子。这次是我替她带的。
lines.en: Don't mix up Mira's medicine. The wrong one gives her a rash. This time I'm picking it up for her.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 还有那个扳手，别拿细柄的。那种断了，差点割到我。
lines.en: And the wrench—not the thin-handled one. That kind snapped and nearly cut me.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这次我自己出钱，别记在队里头上。
lines.en: This time it's my money. Don't put it on the unit.

blocks.scene: 日常 G1—G2 队里的习惯

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 他们现在会先问我，这件东西值不值。我说先看接口，再看价钱。
lines.en: Now they ask me first whether something's worth it. I say check the fittings first, price second.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 别看我说得顺，都是你教的。
lines.en: Don't think I sound smooth. You taught me.

blocks.scene: 日常 G1—G2 旧日记忆

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这个牌子的扣子不能硬掰。认得，没什么好夸的。
lines.en: You can't force the clasp on this brand. Knowing it isn't worth praising.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 扣子给我留着，别当废料称。
lines.en: Keep the buttons for me. Don't weigh them as scrap.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 新来的那个，第一次出任务吐了一路。我没吐，我手抖。
lines.en: The new one threw up the whole first mission. I didn't throw up. My hands shook.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 现在先看货，抖不抖另说。带新人先教他们别把枪口对着自己人。
lines.en: Look at the goods first. Whether I shake is another matter. The first thing you teach a new one is not to point a gun at your own people.

blocks.scene: 日常 G2—G3 没有货的短访

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 今天不买什么，就看看。你忙你的，我看完就走。还没看完，你别催。
lines.en: Not buying anything today. Just looking. Do your work. I'll go when I'm done. I'm not done yet. Don't rush me.

blocks.scene: 日常 完成后 饼干

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你店里那种饼干还有吗？
lines.en: Do you still have those biscuits?

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 拿两盒，一盒给队里，一盒放你这儿，我下次来吃。
lines.en: Two boxes. One for the unit, one here. I'll eat it next time.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 那孩子不知道爱不爱吃甜的，先买着，吃不吃随他。
lines.en: I don't know if the kid likes sweets. I'll buy it anyway. Whether he eats it is up to him.

blocks.scene: 日常 完成后 打盹

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 我坐一会儿。别关灯。不用叫我，我睡不沉。
lines.en: I'll sit for a while. Don't turn off the light. You don't have to wake me. I don't sleep deep.

blocks.scene: 日常 完成后 挑剔

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 这个摆得难看。我来摆。行了，别动。
lines.en: This is displayed badly. Let me do it. There. Don't touch it.

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 别动。我刚摆好。
lines.en: Don't touch it. I just fixed it.

blocks.scene: 日常 完成后 短暂亲近

lines.speaker: eleanor
lines.text: 你忙你的。我本来也没打算走。闭嘴可以，别走。
lines.en: Do your work. I wasn't planning to leave anyway. You can shut up. Don't leave.
